cryptanalysis.readabilityHint: Readability is relative: 100 marks the best of the tested candidates, not a guarantee that the text makes sense.

confidence.enough: This guess clearly stands out from the others.
confidence.limited: Short message or close scores: statistics cannot conclude with certainty. Read the top guesses and judge for yourself.

caesar.empty: Enter a ciphertext containing at least one letter to test the 26 shifts.

table.caption: The 26 shifts tested, with the resulting text

caesar.explain: With only 26 possible keys, the Caesar cipher is broken by brute force: we try every shift and look for the one that produces readable text. Readability is estimated from letter frequencies and the presence of common words.
